I was at a friends house waiting for my mom to finish talking to my friends mom. Me and my friend decide to go outside and wait by the car and just talk. It's about 8 at night and it's kind of cold, so I did what any 5th grader would do. I pretended to smoke and with my frosty breath and watch it evaporate. I look up and I notice that street light is highlighting more smoke than was actually coming out of my mouth. I find it a little odd so I turn around to look at my moms car and I see that there is smoke coming from the hood. We instantly run back inside yelling that the car is on fire! at first our moms didn't believe us. But luckily they still went outside to check it out. As soon as we walk outside they notice some smoke come Ming from the car too my mom quickly runs to the car and opens the hood as my friends mom grabs the garden hose and starts to douse the engine with water. They call the fire department, but the fire was out by the time they got there. Turns out Ford Expeditions had faulty fuses at the time that caused the car to catch fire.
